text: Checked the engine's latest measurements for the Pinnacle-first idea. The Pinnacle feed it already uses is under 1 second old at p90 and is asked every scan. The Odds API shows 'not measured' because it stays asleep while better feeds answer. Its Pinnacle prices come from a polled board, so they can't beat a sub-second feed. I'm leaving the order as is and won't spend your Odds API credits on Pinnacle. If the Pinnacle feed ever goes stale, the engine's ranking by measured freshness will move the Odds API up on its own.
